flagged.evidence: The Definition calls the real translations “the τ-fixed skew-Hermitian bispinors,” then identifies the same $T_{\alpha\dot\beta}$ with the Hermitian matrix $\sigma^\mu_{\alpha\dot\beta}P_\mu$. At the stated nonzero rest momentum, $P_0=-M$, so this identification gives $T=-MI_2$, which is Hermitian, contradicting the skew-Hermitian condition. The algebra generator and Hermitian momentum therefore cannot be identified as written.

flagged.evidence: The Example says “Choose the fundamental representation $R_{\mathrm f}:SU(2)\to U(\mathbb C^2)$” and gives Hermitian generators, but never states its finite action. It later uses $\phi'=h^{-1}\phi$ and step 1.2 uses $R_{\mathrm f}(h)$ as matrix multiplication. The general representation supplier defines a group homomorphism but does not supply this particular map; the Example needs to state $R_{\mathrm f}(h)v=hv$ for $h\in SU(2)\subset M_2(\mathbb C)$ and $v\in\mathbb C^2$. This is a readily repairable omission.
